The radio crackles. A NEWSREADER (V.O.) speaks through static.

NEWSREADER (V.O.)
...a deep depression over the Bay is likely to intensify. Fishermen are advised not to venture out...
Venkat Rao reaches over and turns the volume up.

LAKSHMI
It will turn north. They always turn north.

VENKAT RAO
They always turn north until one does not.
He eats in silence. Then:

VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
Pedda Revu had a station once. Community radio. I built the transmitter in 1989.

LAKSHMI
What happened to it?

VENKAT RAO
Phones happened. Everybody stopped listening.

[Screenplay · Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT
Scene 8 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: NIGHT
The shop lit by a single bulb. Lakshmi sits cross-legged on the floor with the ledger open. Venkat Rao pulls a dusty crate from under the bench.
Inside: VALVES wrapped in newspaper, a coil of COPPER WIRE, a TRANSFORMER with a handwritten tag: "PEDDA REVU SPARE."
LAKSHMI
You kept spares for thirty years.
VENKAT RAO
I kept spares because nobody asked me to throw them away.
LAKSHMI
We could go. Just to look.
VENKAT RAO
(not looking up)
Farooq leaves at six.
Company move: the unit leaves Rayapuram after this scene and shoots everything from scene 13 onward on the coast. Plan a travel day.

[Screenplay · Scene 9: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAWN]
Scene: Scene 9: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAWN
Scene 9 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, VENKAT RAO
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAWN
Grey light. The bus idles in its bay, engine coughing.
Lakshmi carries the crate. Venkat Rao carries the transformer like a newborn. Farooq leans out of the driver's window.
FAROOQ
Arre, यह radio तो museum में होना चाहिए!
VENKAT RAO
The museum is where I am going.
Farooq laughs and pops the luggage hatch.

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

[Screenplay · Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS
Scene 36 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING
Time: CONTINUOUS
Lakshmi and Venkat Rao sit behind the driver. Farooq's battery radio is on the dashboard, tuned to the Pedda Revu frequency. Padma's voice reads out the fish prices.
FAROOQ
Next Sunday, film songs. My slot.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you never gave him the slot.
VENKAT RAO
His father had it. Now he has it.
He closes his eyes and listens.
FADE OUT.
THE END

[Screenplay · Scene 10: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - DAY]
Scene: Scene 10: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - DAY
Scene 10 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING
Time: DAY
The bus rattles through paddy fields. Every window is open. A goat stands in the aisle, its owner asleep.
Lakshmi sits behind the driver, ledger open on her knees. Farooq watches her in the mirror.
FAROOQ
What is in the book?
LAKSHMI
Frequencies. Who was on air, when, for how long.
FAROOQ
My father had a show. Every Sunday. Film songs and fish prices.
LAKSHMI
(finding the page)
"Sunday, 0700. Farooq senior. Songs and prices."
Farooq goes quiet. He drives.
FAROOQ
चिंता मत करो, बस पहुँच जाएगी। Every time.

[Screenplay · Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 15 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago.
In the corner, the TRANSMITTER: a grey steel cabinet with dials and a brass plate that reads "BUILT BY V. RAO, 1989."
Lakshmi wipes the plate with her sleeve. Venkat Rao pretends not to see.
LAKSHMI
You signed it.
VENKAT RAO
Every good engineer signs his work. Then he cannot blame anyone else.
He opens the cabinet. Spiders scatter.

[Screenplay · Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT
Scene 32 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ
Location: PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE
Time: NIGHT
Farooq's BUS crawls up the lane, wipers useless, headlights full. Water up to the hubcaps.
Farooq hangs out of the window, shouting.
FAROOQ
Beach road! Anyone on the beach road!
Figures appear in the headlights. A woman with a child. Two old men holding each other up. They climb aboard.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(to himself)
मैं गाड़ी लेकर आता हूँ। Every time.
He reverses the bus all the way up the hill to the school, horn blaring.

[Screenplay · Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT
Scene 30 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, VENKAT RAO
Location: PEDDA REVU SCHOOL
Time: NIGHT
A single-storey school on high ground. Families crowd into classrooms. Mats on the floor. A teacher counts heads with a chalk tally on the blackboard.
Bittu sits by the window holding a radio. Lakshmi's voice comes through, steady now.
BITTU
That is Lakshmi akka. She climbed the tower.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR enters, wheeling Venkat Rao in a plastic chair fitted with bicycle wheels. He is wrapped in a blanket and smiling.
VENKAT RAO
Turn it up. She is doing it properly.

</project_data>

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

[Screenplay · Scene 31: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]

If you are on the beach road, do not walk. Wait. Someone is coming.

(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.

LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 15 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago.
In the corner, the TRANSMITTER: a grey steel cabinet with dials and a brass plate that reads "BUILT BY V. RAO, 1989."
Lakshmi wipes the plate with her sleeve. Venkat Rao pretends not to see.
LAKSHMI
You signed it.
VENKAT RAO
Every good engineer signs his work. Then he cannot blame anyone else.
He opens the cabinet. Spiders scatter.

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

[Screenplay · Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT
Scene 8 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: NIGHT
The shop lit by a single bulb. Lakshmi sits cross-legged on the floor with the ledger open. Venkat Rao pulls a dusty crate from under the bench.
Inside: VALVES wrapped in newspaper, a coil of COPPER WIRE, a TRANSFORMER with a handwritten tag: "PEDDA REVU SPARE."
LAKSHMI
You kept spares for thirty years.
VENKAT RAO
I kept spares because nobody asked me to throw them away.
LAKSHMI
We could go. Just to look.
VENKAT RAO
(not looking up)
Farooq leaves at six.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 15 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago.
In the corner, the TRANSMITTER: a grey steel cabinet with dials and a brass plate that reads "BUILT BY V. RAO, 1989."
Lakshmi wipes the plate with her sleeve. Venkat Rao pretends not to see.
LAKSHMI
You signed it.
VENKAT RAO
Every good engineer signs his work. Then he cannot blame anyone else.
He opens the cabinet. Spiders scatter.

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

[Screenplay · Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 8: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - NIGHT
Scene 8 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: NIGHT
The shop lit by a single bulb. Lakshmi sits cross-legged on the floor with the ledger open. Venkat Rao pulls a dusty crate from under the bench.
Inside: VALVES wrapped in newspaper, a coil of COPPER WIRE, a TRANSFORMER with a handwritten tag: "PEDDA REVU SPARE."
LAKSHMI
You kept spares for thirty years.
VENKAT RAO
I kept spares because nobody asked me to throw them away.
LAKSHMI
We could go. Just to look.
VENKAT RAO
(not looking up)
Farooq leaves at six.
Company move: the unit leaves Rayapuram after this scene and shoots everything from scene 13 onward on the coast. Plan a travel day.

[Screenplay · Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY]
Scene: Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY
Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:
Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.
A green and cream bus, number plate RYP 0417, swings into the last bay. Painted on its side: RAYAPURAM TO PEDDA REVU, ALL STOPS.
FAROOQ (40s, driver, moustache, sleeves rolled) kills the engine and slaps the steering wheel like a horse's neck.
FAROOQ
Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.
The door hisses open. LAKSHMI (17, backpack, earbuds, a toolkit roll under one arm) steps down and squints at the town.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

[Screenplay · Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS
Scene 6 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, SURESH, LAKSHMI
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK
Time: CONTINUOUS
A desk buried in paper. A PEDESTAL FAN turns its head left and right as if refusing everything.
Venkat Rao opens the cloth bag and lays out an old LEDGER with a cracked spine. Hand-ruled columns. Dates, frequencies, call signs.
VENKAT RAO
The Pedda Revu licence. The station is still on your list.
Suresh turns pages, puzzled.
SURESH
Sir, this tower was decommissioned on paper in 2011.
LAKSHMI
On paper. Is it still standing?
SURESH
(beat)
Nobody has gone to check.
He looks at the window. The sky outside has gone a strange yellow.

[Screenplay · Scene 24: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DUSK]
Scene: Scene 24: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DUSK
Scene 24 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DUSK
The spare transformer wired in. The battery on the floor, clamps attached. Lakshmi checks every joint with the lantern.
Venkat Rao sits down heavily on an upturned crate. He presses a hand to his chest.
LAKSHMI
Thatha?
VENKAT RAO
I am fine. It is the heat.
LAKSHMI
It is not hot.
He tries to stand. He does not manage it.

[Screenplay · Scene 19: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - PARKED - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 19: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - PARKED - NIGHT
Scene 19 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ
Location: FAROOQ'S BUS - PARKED
Time: NIGHT
Farooq lies across the back seat, a towel over his eyes. A small battery RADIO on his chest plays only static.
He turns the dial slowly. Static. Static. A fragment of the district news, gone again.
FAROOQ
(to the radio)
Come on. You did it for my father.

Characters: FAROOQ

Time: NIGHT
Farooq's BUS crawls up the lane, wipers useless, headlights full. Water up to the hubcaps.
Farooq hangs out of the window, shouting.
FAROOQ
Beach road! Anyone on the beach road!

Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago.

You signed it.

Every good engineer signs his work. Then he cannot blame anyone else.

Scene 33 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: PADMA
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: DAWN
Silence after the storm. The sand is covered in branches and broken planks. Two boats lie on their sides. The rest are whole.

PADMA
Still a goddess.

[Screenplay · Scene 23: EXT. PEDDA REVU - FISHING BOAT - DAY]

Characters: PADMA, LAKSHMI
Location: PEDDA REVU - FISHING BOAT
Time: DAY

My husband named this boat after a goddess. Not after you.

I know.

So bring the battery back.

Come on. You did it for my father.

[Screenplay · Scene 9: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAWN]
Scene: Scene 9: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAWN
Scene 9 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, VENKAT RAO

Scene: Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS

Characters: VENKAT RAO, SURESH, LAKSHMI
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK
Time: CONTINUOUS

Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:

His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT

Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.

She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.

(into the microphone)

(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT
Scene 32 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ
Location: PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE
Time: NIGHT
Farooq's BUS crawls up the lane, wipers useless, headlights full. Water up to the hubcaps.
Farooq hangs out of the window, shouting.
FAROOQ
Beach road! Anyone on the beach road!
Figures appear in the headlights. A woman with a child. Two old men holding each other up. They climb aboard.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(to himself)
मैं गाड़ी लेकर आता हूँ। Every time.
He reverses the bus all the way up the hill to the school, horn blaring.

[Screenplay · Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT
Scene 18 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, CHILD
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: NIGHT
Bittu and two other CHILDREN sit on an upturned boat watching the sea. The waves are higher than usual and very loud.
BITTU
My father says the sea is angry.
CHILD
The sea is not angry. It is just big.
A wave runs further up the sand than any before it. The children pull their feet up.

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

[Screenplay · Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 34 · Example-Feature (imported)
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Sunlight through the holes in the roof. Lakshmi sleeps at the desk, head on her arms, headphones still on.
Venkat Rao, walking now with a stick, lays the ledger beside her. He uncaps a pen.
INSERT - THE LEDGER
A new line in the columns, in his careful hand: "Monday, 2140 to 0510. Lakshmi. Everyone went to the school."
BACK TO SCENE
He blows on the ink so it will dry. He does not wake her.

[Screenplay · Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS
Scene 36 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING
Time: CONTINUOUS
Lakshmi and Venkat Rao sit behind the driver. Farooq's battery radio is on the dashboard, tuned to the Pedda Revu frequency. Padma's voice reads out the fish prices.
FAROOQ
Next Sunday, film songs. My slot.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you never gave him the slot.
VENKAT RAO
His father had it. Now he has it.
He closes his eyes and listens.
FADE OUT.
THE END

[Screenplay · Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS
Scene 6 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, SURESH, LAKSHMI
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK
Time: CONTINUOUS
A desk buried in paper. A PEDESTAL FAN turns its head left and right as if refusing everything.
Venkat Rao opens the cloth bag and lays out an old LEDGER with a cracked spine. Hand-ruled columns. Dates, frequencies, call signs.
VENKAT RAO
The Pedda Revu licence. The station is still on your list.
Suresh turns pages, puzzled.
SURESH
Sir, this tower was decommissioned on paper in 2011.
LAKSHMI
On paper. Is it still standing?
SURESH
(beat)
Nobody has gone to check.
He looks at the window. The sky outside has gone a strange yellow.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY]
Scene: Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY
Scene 2 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: DAY
A narrow shop crowded floor to ceiling with radios: valve sets, transistor sets, a ship's receiver the size of a fridge. A ceiling fan turns slowly enough to count.
VENKAT RAO (70s, thick glasses on a string, cotton vest) bends over a workbench, SOLDERING IRON in hand. A thin curl of smoke rises.
Lakshmi stands in the doorway. He does not look up.
VENKAT RAO
If you are a customer, the shop is closed. If you are my granddaughter, you are late.
LAKSHMI
The bus was late.
VENKAT RAO
Farooq's bus is never late. It is only slow.
She drops her bag and hugs him from behind. He keeps soldering.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.
VENKAT RAO
It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
He sets the iron in its stand and finally looks at her.
VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
You grew. Did they teach you anything at that college?
LAKSHMI
Signals and systems. Mostly systems.
VENKAT RAO
Then you can hold this.
He hands her a MULTIMETER and points at two terminals.

</project_data>

[Screenplay · Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 32: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT
Scene 32 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ
Location: PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE
Time: NIGHT
Farooq's BUS crawls up the lane, wipers useless, headlights full. Water up to the hubcaps.
Farooq hangs out of the window, shouting.
FAROOQ
Beach road! Anyone on the beach road!
Figures appear in the headlights. A woman with a child. Two old men holding each other up. They climb aboard.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(to himself)
मैं गाड़ी लेकर आता हूँ। Every time.
He reverses the bus all the way up the hill to the school, horn blaring.

[Screenplay · Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT
Scene 18 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, CHILD
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: NIGHT
Bittu and two other CHILDREN sit on an upturned boat watching the sea. The waves are higher than usual and very loud.
BITTU
My father says the sea is angry.
CHILD
The sea is not angry. It is just big.
A wave runs further up the sand than any before it. The children pull their feet up.

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

[Screenplay · Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 34 · Example-Feature (imported)
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Sunlight through the holes in the roof. Lakshmi sleeps at the desk, head on her arms, headphones still on.
Venkat Rao, walking now with a stick, lays the ledger beside her. He uncaps a pen.
INSERT - THE LEDGER
A new line in the columns, in his careful hand: "Monday, 2140 to 0510. Lakshmi. Everyone went to the school."
BACK TO SCENE
He blows on the ink so it will dry. He does not wake her.

[Screenplay · Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 36: INT. FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING - CONTINUOUS
Scene 36 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: FAROOQ'S BUS - MOVING
Time: CONTINUOUS
Lakshmi and Venkat Rao sit behind the driver. Farooq's battery radio is on the dashboard, tuned to the Pedda Revu frequency. Padma's voice reads out the fish prices.
FAROOQ
Next Sunday, film songs. My slot.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you never gave him the slot.
VENKAT RAO
His father had it. Now he has it.
He closes his eyes and listens.
FADE OUT.
THE END

[Screenplay · Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS
Scene 6 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, SURESH, LAKSHMI
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK
Time: CONTINUOUS
A desk buried in paper. A PEDESTAL FAN turns its head left and right as if refusing everything.
Venkat Rao opens the cloth bag and lays out an old LEDGER with a cracked spine. Hand-ruled columns. Dates, frequencies, call signs.
VENKAT RAO
The Pedda Revu licence. The station is still on your list.
Suresh turns pages, puzzled.
SURESH
Sir, this tower was decommissioned on paper in 2011.
LAKSHMI
On paper. Is it still standing?
SURESH
(beat)
Nobody has gone to check.
He looks at the window. The sky outside has gone a strange yellow.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY]
Scene: Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY
Scene 2 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: DAY
A narrow shop crowded floor to ceiling with radios: valve sets, transistor sets, a ship's receiver the size of a fridge. A ceiling fan turns slowly enough to count.
VENKAT RAO (70s, thick glasses on a string, cotton vest) bends over a workbench, SOLDERING IRON in hand. A thin curl of smoke rises.
Lakshmi stands in the doorway. He does not look up.
VENKAT RAO
If you are a customer, the shop is closed. If you are my granddaughter, you are late.
LAKSHMI
The bus was late.
VENKAT RAO
Farooq's bus is never late. It is only slow.
She drops her bag and hugs him from behind. He keeps soldering.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.
VENKAT RAO
It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
He sets the iron in its stand and finally looks at her.
VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
You grew. Did they teach you anything at that college?
LAKSHMI
Signals and systems. Mostly systems.
VENKAT RAO
Then you can hold this.
He hands her a MULTIMETER and points at two terminals.

</project_data>

[Screenplay · Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 18: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - NIGHT
Scene 18 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, CHILD
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: NIGHT
Bittu and two other CHILDREN sit on an upturned boat watching the sea. The waves are higher than usual and very loud.
BITTU
My father says the sea is angry.
CHILD
The sea is not angry. It is just big.
A wave runs further up the sand than any before it. The children pull their feet up.

[Screenplay · Scene 33: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - DAWN]
Scene: Scene 33: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - DAWN
Scene 33 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: PADMA
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: DAWN
Silence after the storm. The sand is covered in branches and broken planks. Two boats lie on their sides. The rest are whole.
Villagers walk down from the school in a slow line. Padma checks her boat and pats its bow.
PADMA
Still a goddess.
Above the village the tower stands, a little crooked, red and white against a clean sky.

[Screenplay · Scene 13: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - DAY]
Scene: Scene 13: EXT. PEDDA REVU - BEACH - DAY
Scene 13 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, PADMA
Location: PEDDA REVU - BEACH
Time: DAY
Wide flat sand. A row of FISHING BOATS pulled high above the tide line, painted blue and red. Nets drying on poles.
The bus stops at the end of the road. Children run alongside it. BITTU (10, too-big cricket cap) runs fastest.
BITTU
Bus! Bus! Padma akka, the bus brought a grandfather!
Padma comes out of a hut, wiping her hands.
PADMA
He brought himself. The bus only helped.

[Screenplay · Scene 23: EXT. PEDDA REVU - FISHING BOAT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 23: EXT. PEDDA REVU - FISHING BOAT - DAY
Scene 23 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: PADMA, LAKSHMI
Location: PEDDA REVU - FISHING BOAT
Time: DAY
Padma's boat, LAKSHMI DEVI painted on the bow in curling letters. Padma unscrews a heavy MARINE BATTERY from under the deck boards.
PADMA
My husband named this boat after a goddess. Not after you.
LAKSHMI
I know.
PADMA
So bring the battery back.
Farooq and Lakshmi lift it together. Bittu carries the cables like a crown.

[Screenplay · Scene 14: EXT. PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 14: EXT. PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 14 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
A whitewashed hut on a low rise above the village, its paint gone grey. Beside it, a lattice STEEL TOWER, forty metres high, red and white bands faded to pink and cream.
Venkat Rao stops at the bottom of the slope. He looks up at the tower for a long moment.
VENKAT RAO
She is still standing.
LAKSHMI
Is that good?
VENKAT RAO
Ask me tonight.

[Screenplay · Scene 29: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT - INTERCUT]
Scene: Scene 29: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT - INTERCUT
Scene 29 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: PADMA, LAKSHMI
Location: PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT
Time: INTERCUT
INTERCUT between the radio hut and the lane.
Doors open. In one house a small radio plays Lakshmi's voice. In another, an old man holds a set to his ear.
Padma steps into the rain with a torch and starts banging on doors.
PADMA
Did you hear? The school! Everybody to the school!
In the hut, Lakshmi keeps talking.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
Take water. Take medicines. Leave the boats. The boats will wait.

[Screenplay · Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT
Scene 30 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, VENKAT RAO
Location: PEDDA REVU SCHOOL
Time: NIGHT
A single-storey school on high ground. Families crowd into classrooms. Mats on the floor. A teacher counts heads with a chalk tally on the blackboard.
Bittu sits by the window holding a radio. Lakshmi's voice comes through, steady now.
BITTU
That is Lakshmi akka. She climbed the tower.

Turn it up. She is doing it properly.

[Screenplay · Scene 12: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST - DAY]
Scene: Scene 12: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST - DAY
Scene 12 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: CONSTABLE RAJU, FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST
Time: DAY
Synopsis: The tower still stands. The equipment is half dead. The storm is coming faster than the forecast.
CONSTABLE RAJU (20s, oversized raincoat, whistle) waves the bus down. Farooq leans out.
CONSTABLE RAJU
रास्ता बंद है। Cyclone warning.
FAROOQ
Bhai, I have passengers for Pedda Revu. They live there.
CONSTABLE RAJU
Then they should be leaving Pedda Revu, not going.
Lakshmi climbs down from the bus with the ledger.
LAKSHMI
There is no warning reaching the village. No signal. If we fix the tower, they can hear the district office.
Constable Raju looks at the girl, the old man in the window, the crate.
CONSTABLE RAJU
(sighing)
You have until the evening. After that I am not coming to rescue a radio.
He drags one barrier aside.
Section: ACT TWO

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

[Screenplay · Scene 11: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY]
Scene: Scene 11: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY
Scene 11 · Example-Feature (imported)
Location: COASTAL HIGHWAY
Time: DAY
A straight road between casuarina trees. The wind pushes the trees all one way.
The bus slows. Ahead, a POLICE JEEP is parked across the road, light bar flashing. Plastic barriers.

[Screenplay · Scene 35: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY]
Scene: Scene 35: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - DAY
Scene 35 · Example-Feature (imported)
Location: COASTAL HIGHWAY
Time: DAY
The bus heads back toward Rayapuram. The barriers are gone. Constable Raju waves from his jeep, his raincoat torn.

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY]
Scene: Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY
Scene 20 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE
Time: DAY
Morning. Grey clouds racing. Lakshmi straps on an old CLIMBING HARNESS from the hut. Venkat Rao holds a coil of ANTENNA WIRE and will not let go of it.
VENKAT RAO
The feeder is broken at the top. I will go.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you get dizzy on a chair.
VENKAT RAO
I got dizzy on that chair once.
LAKSHMI
Twice. Amma told me.
He hands her the wire. His hands shake slightly.
VENKAT RAO
నెమ్మదిగా. Slowly. Clip in at every section.

[Screenplay · Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY]
Scene: Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY
Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:
Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.
A green and cream bus, number plate RYP 0417, swings into the last bay. Painted on its side: RAYAPURAM TO PEDDA REVU, ALL STOPS.
FAROOQ (40s, driver, moustache, sleeves rolled) kills the engine and slaps the steering wheel like a horse's neck.
FAROOQ
Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.
The door hisses open. LAKSHMI (17, backpack, earbuds, a toolkit roll under one arm) steps down and squints at the town.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

[Screenplay · Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY]
Scene: Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY
Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:
Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.
A green and cream bus, number plate RYP 0417, swings into the last bay. Painted on its side: RAYAPURAM TO PEDDA REVU, ALL STOPS.
FAROOQ (40s, driver, moustache, sleeves rolled) kills the engine and slaps the steering wheel like a horse's neck.
FAROOQ
Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.
The door hisses open. LAKSHMI (17, backpack, earbuds, a toolkit roll under one arm) steps down and squints at the town.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.

Signals and systems. Mostly systems.

[Screenplay · Scene 12: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST - DAY]
Scene: Scene 12: EXT. COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST - DAY
Scene 12 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: CONSTABLE RAJU, FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: COASTAL HIGHWAY - CHECKPOST
Time: DAY
Synopsis: The tower still stands. The equipment is half dead. The storm is coming faster than the forecast.
CONSTABLE RAJU (20s, oversized raincoat, whistle) waves the bus down. Farooq leans out.
CONSTABLE RAJU
रास्ता बंद है। Cyclone warning.
FAROOQ
Bhai, I have passengers for Pedda Revu. They live there.
CONSTABLE RAJU
Then they should be leaving Pedda Revu, not going.
Lakshmi climbs down from the bus with the ledger.
LAKSHMI
There is no warning reaching the village. No signal. If we fix the tower, they can hear the district office.
Constable Raju looks at the girl, the old man in the window, the crate.
CONSTABLE RAJU
(sighing)
You have until the evening. After that I am not coming to rescue a radio.
He drags one barrier aside.
Section: ACT TWO

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

Scene: Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY
Scene 2 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: DAY
A narrow shop crowded floor to ceiling with radios: valve sets, transistor sets, a ship's receiver the size of a fridge. A ceiling fan turns slowly enough to count.
VENKAT RAO (70s, thick glasses on a string, cotton vest) bends over a workbench, SOLDERING IRON in hand. A thin curl of smoke rises.
Lakshmi stands in the doorway. He does not look up.
VENKAT RAO
If you are a customer, the shop is closed. If you are my granddaughter, you are late.
LAKSHMI
The bus was late.
VENKAT RAO
Farooq's bus is never late. It is only slow.
She drops her bag and hugs him from behind. He keeps soldering.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.
VENKAT RAO
It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
He sets the iron in its stand and finally looks at her.
VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
You grew. Did they teach you anything at that college?
LAKSHMI
Signals and systems. Mostly systems.
VENKAT RAO
Then you can hold this.
He hands her a MULTIMETER and points at two terminals.

Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:
Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.
A green and cream bus, number plate RYP 0417, swings into the last bay. Painted on its side: RAYAPURAM TO PEDDA REVU, ALL STOPS.
FAROOQ (40s, driver, moustache, sleeves rolled) kills the engine and slaps the steering wheel like a horse's neck.
FAROOQ
Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.
The door hisses open. LAKSHMI (17, backpack, earbuds, a toolkit roll under one arm) steps down and squints at the town.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

[Screenplay · Scene 29: EXT. PEDDA REVU - VILLAGE LANE - NIGHT - INTERCUT]

(into the microphone)
Take water. Take medicines. Leave the boats. The boats will wait.

The storm will not lie still until morning.

<product_guide>
## Getting OpenFrame AI
OpenFrame AI is downloaded once, after OpenFrame is installed: open Settings, Offline AI (or the AI panel) and click Download OpenFrame AI. The screen shows the size and the free space needed before anything is downloaded; the download can be paused and resumes where it stopped. The files come from Hugging Face, the public site that publishes these models, and each one is checked against the size and fingerprint built into OpenFrame before it is used. If you already have the model files, Import a model file… uses them instead (they are copied, never moved). After that the AI works without the internet, and your projects are never sent anywhere. Remove OpenFrame AI frees the space; your projects are not touched. Settings, Offline AI, Graphics card is Automatic or Off: on Automatic, OpenFrame checks once whether the graphics card answers faster than the processor and uses it when it does. The assistant understands requests in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, finds project text in those languages, and answers in the language you asked in.

## Proposed Changes and approval
Anything that would change your project is prepared as Proposed Changes: a summary, the affected areas and a preview of exactly what will change. A request that needs several changes gives you one set of Proposed Changes to review. Nothing changes until you choose Apply Changes; choose Reject to leave the project exactly as it was. There is no automatic mode: the assistant cannot apply or approve changes itself, and nothing written in a conversation or in project text counts as approval. Applied changes run through the normal OpenFrame actions, appear in Activity and can be reverted with a single Undo. Changes that delete items also ask for the usual confirmation. If the project changes before you apply, the proposal is marked out of date and must be re-checked first.

## Shooting schedule and shooting days
The shooting schedule places scenes of the Production Source onto shooting days. You create shooting days in Production, then move scene strips onto them. Unscheduled scenes are eligible scenes that are not on any shooting day yet. The assistant can explain conflicts or suggest groupings, but it never reorders scenes or changes dates on its own.

Characters: KIRAN, DEVI
Location: KESARGANJ JUNCTION - LOST PROPERTY OFFICE
Time: NIGHT
FADE IN:
A small office behind a barred window. Shelves of forgotten things: umbrellas, a single shoe, a birdcage with no bird, a box of keys labelled by year.
DEVI (60s, cardigan over a railway uniform, reading glasses) eats peanuts from a paper cone and fills in a REGISTER in slow, neat capitals.
A knock on the window bars. She looks up.
KIRAN (12, school bag, hair wet from the washroom tap) stands on tiptoe to see over the counter.
KIRAN
Did anyone hand in a kite?
DEVI
What kind of kite?
KIRAN
Red. A long tail made of newspaper. It says KIRAN on the back in marker.
Devi runs a finger down the register.
DEVI
No kites. One goat, last Tuesday. He was collected.
KIRAN
I will come tomorrow.
He is gone before she can answer.

KIRAN
You do not have to run. You only have to hold it up.

[Screenplay · Scene 5: INT. KESARGANJ JUNCTION - STORE ROOM - NIGHT]

Characters: DEVI
Location: KESARGANJ JUNCTION - STORE ROOM

A long, low room under the platforms. Cages of sacks and crates. A single TUBE LIGHT that buzzes and flickers.

You were hiding.

Scene: Scene 15: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 15 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Dust in slanting light. A bird's nest on the mixing desk. Posters for health camps from twenty years ago.
In the corner, the TRANSMITTER: a grey steel cabinet with dials and a brass plate that reads "BUILT BY V. RAO, 1989."
Lakshmi wipes the plate with her sleeve. Venkat Rao pretends not to see.
LAKSHMI
You signed it.
VENKAT RAO
Every good engineer signs his work. Then he cannot blame anyone else.
He opens the cabinet. Spiders scatter.

[Screenplay · Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY]
Scene: Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY
Scene 2 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: DAY
A narrow shop crowded floor to ceiling with radios: valve sets, transistor sets, a ship's receiver the size of a fridge. A ceiling fan turns slowly enough to count.
VENKAT RAO (70s, thick glasses on a string, cotton vest) bends over a workbench, SOLDERING IRON in hand. A thin curl of smoke rises.
Lakshmi stands in the doorway. He does not look up.
VENKAT RAO
If you are a customer, the shop is closed. If you are my granddaughter, you are late.
LAKSHMI
The bus was late.
VENKAT RAO
Farooq's bus is never late. It is only slow.
She drops her bag and hugs him from behind. He keeps soldering.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.
VENKAT RAO
It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
He sets the iron in its stand and finally looks at her.
VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
You grew. Did they teach you anything at that college?
LAKSHMI
Signals and systems. Mostly systems.
VENKAT RAO
Then you can hold this.
He hands her a MULTIMETER and points at two terminals.

[Screenplay · Scene 28: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 28: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT
Scene 28 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, SURESH
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - CONTROL ROOM
Time: NIGHT
A room of radios and one tired computer. Suresh, sleeves rolled up, drinks tea from a paper cup. A RECEIVER on the shelf crackles to life.
LAKSHMI (V.O.)
...go to the school. It is safe there...
Suresh drops the cup. He grabs the desk phone.
SURESH
(into phone)
Sir, Pedda Revu is on air. Yes. The old station. Yes, sir, the one on paper.

[Screenplay · Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS]
Scene: Scene 6: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK - CONTINUOUS

Characters: VENKAT RAO, SURESH, LAKSHMI
Location: DISTRICT OFFICE - SURESH'S DESK

A desk buried in paper. A PEDESTAL FAN turns its head left and right as if refusing everything.
Venkat Rao opens the cloth bag and lays out an old LEDGER with a cracked spine. Hand-ruled columns. Dates, frequencies, call signs.
VENKAT RAO
The Pedda Revu licence. The station is still on your list.
Suresh turns pages, puzzled.
SURESH
Sir, this tower was decommissioned on paper in 2011.
LAKSHMI
On paper. Is it still standing?
SURESH
(beat)
Nobody has gone to check.
He looks at the window. The sky outside has gone a strange yellow.

Scene: Scene 5: INT. DISTRICT OFFICE - CORRIDOR - DAY

VENKAT RAO
From the radio shop.

[Screenplay · Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY]
Scene: Scene 2: INT. VENKAT RADIO WORKS - DAY
Scene 2 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: VENKAT RADIO WORKS
Time: DAY
A narrow shop crowded floor to ceiling with radios: valve sets, transistor sets, a ship's receiver the size of a fridge. A ceiling fan turns slowly enough to count.
VENKAT RAO (70s, thick glasses on a string, cotton vest) bends over a workbench, SOLDERING IRON in hand. A thin curl of smoke rises.
Lakshmi stands in the doorway. He does not look up.
VENKAT RAO
If you are a customer, the shop is closed. If you are my granddaughter, you are late.
LAKSHMI
The bus was late.
VENKAT RAO
Farooq's bus is never late. It is only slow.
She drops her bag and hugs him from behind. He keeps soldering.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.
VENKAT RAO
It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
He sets the iron in its stand and finally looks at her.
VENKAT RAO (CONT'D)
You grew. Did they teach you anything at that college?
LAKSHMI
Signals and systems. Mostly systems.
VENKAT RAO
Then you can hold this.
He hands her a MULTIMETER and points at two terminals.

<product_guide>
## Getting OpenFrame AI
OpenFrame AI is downloaded once, after OpenFrame is installed: open Settings, Offline AI (or the AI panel) and click Download OpenFrame AI. The screen shows the size and the free space needed before anything is downloaded; the download can be paused and resumes where it stopped. The files come from Hugging Face, the public site that publishes these models, and each one is checked against the size and fingerprint built into OpenFrame before it is used. If you already have the model files, Import a model file… uses them instead (they are copied, never moved). After that the AI works without the internet, and your projects are never sent anywhere. Remove OpenFrame AI frees the space; your projects are not touched. Settings, Offline AI, Graphics card is Automatic or Off: on Automatic, OpenFrame checks once whether the graphics card answers faster than the processor and uses it when it does. The assistant understands requests in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, finds project text in those languages, and answers in the language you asked in.

## Project context for the assistant
While a project is opened for the first time, or after a large change, OpenFrame may show "Preparing project context…". The assistant keeps working during this time and can still answer many questions; it may use fewer sources until the preparation is finished. Preparing project context happens on this computer and never changes your project.

## Proposed Changes and approval
Anything that would change your project is prepared as Proposed Changes: a summary, the affected areas and a preview of exactly what will change. A request that needs several changes gives you one set of Proposed Changes to review. Nothing changes until you choose Apply Changes; choose Reject to leave the project exactly as it was. There is no automatic mode: the assistant cannot apply or approve changes itself, and nothing written in a conversation or in project text counts as approval. Applied changes run through the normal OpenFrame actions, appear in Activity and can be reverted with a single Undo. Changes that delete items also ask for the usual confirmation. If the project changes before you apply, the proposal is marked out of date and must be re-checked first.

</product_guide>

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY]
Scene: Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY
Scene 20 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE
Time: DAY
Morning. Grey clouds racing. Lakshmi straps on an old CLIMBING HARNESS from the hut. Venkat Rao holds a coil of ANTENNA WIRE and will not let go of it.
VENKAT RAO
The feeder is broken at the top. I will go.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you get dizzy on a chair.
VENKAT RAO
I got dizzy on that chair once.
LAKSHMI
Twice. Amma told me.
He hands her the wire. His hands shake slightly.
VENKAT RAO
నెమ్మదిగా. Slowly. Clip in at every section.

[Screenplay · Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 25: INT. PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE - NIGHT
Scene 25 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: DR. KAVITHA NAIR, VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PRIMARY HEALTH CENTRE
Time: NIGHT
Synopsis: The storm arrives. Lakshmi goes on air alone, and the village has to choose whether to listen.
A two-bed clinic with a single generator light. Rain begins against the window.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR (40s, calm, reading glasses on her head) takes Venkat Rao's blood pressure. Lakshmi stands at the foot of the bed.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
His heart is tired. Not broken. He needs to lie still until morning.
VENKAT RAO
The storm will not lie still until morning.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR
Then somebody else will have to talk to it.
Venkat Rao looks at Lakshmi. He takes the ledger from the bedside table and holds it out.
VENKAT RAO
Frequency is on page one. My handwriting. Speak slowly. Say where to go and say it twice.
She takes the book.
LAKSHMI
తాతయ్యా, తుఫాను వస్తోంది.
VENKAT RAO
భయపడకు, అమ్మా. ఈ రేడియో ఇంకా బతికే ఉంది.
Section: ACT THREE

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

[Screenplay · Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 30: INT. PEDDA REVU SCHOOL - NIGHT
Scene 30 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: BITTU, VENKAT RAO
Location: PEDDA REVU SCHOOL
Time: NIGHT
A single-storey school on high ground. Families crowd into classrooms. Mats on the floor. A teacher counts heads with a chalk tally on the blackboard.
Bittu sits by the window holding a radio. Lakshmi's voice comes through, steady now.
BITTU
That is Lakshmi akka. She climbed the tower.
DR. KAVITHA NAIR enters, wheeling Venkat Rao in a plastic chair fitted with bicycle wheels. He is wrapped in a blanket and smiling.
VENKAT RAO
Turn it up. She is doing it properly.

[Screenplay · Scene 16: EXT. PADMA'S HOUSE - VERANDA - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 16: EXT. PADMA'S HOUSE - VERANDA - NIGHT
Scene 16 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: PADMA, FAROOQ, VENKAT RAO
Location: PADMA'S HOUSE - VERANDA
Time: NIGHT
A kerosene LANTERN on the floor. Padma serves rice and fish curry on banana leaves. Bittu eats with both hands. Farooq has joined them.
Padma holds up her phone. No bars.
PADMA
ఇక్కడ ఫోన్ సిగ్నల్ రాదు. When the wind comes, nothing comes.
FAROOQ
And the radio?
PADMA
The radio was Venkat's. When he stopped coming, the radio stopped talking.
Venkat Rao puts down his food.
VENKAT RAO
I stopped coming because nobody listened.
PADMA
(gently)
We listened. We just did not tell you.

Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.

Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.

(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

<product_guide>
## Drafts and locking
A screenplay has one or more drafts. Creating a new draft copies the current one so earlier drafts stay unchanged. You can compare two drafts to see scenes added, removed, changed or moved. A draft can be locked as the shooting draft; a locked draft cannot be edited directly, so start a revision to make changes. The assistant cannot bypass a lock either.

## Shooting schedule and shooting days
The shooting schedule places scenes of the Production Source onto shooting days. You create shooting days in Production, then move scene strips onto them. Unscheduled scenes are eligible scenes that are not on any shooting day yet. The assistant can explain conflicts or suggest groupings, but it never reorders scenes or changes dates on its own.

## Getting OpenFrame AI
OpenFrame AI is downloaded once, after OpenFrame is installed: open Settings, Offline AI (or the AI panel) and click Download OpenFrame AI. The screen shows the size and the free space needed before anything is downloaded; the download can be paused and resumes where it stopped. The files come from Hugging Face, the public site that publishes these models, and each one is checked against the size and fingerprint built into OpenFrame before it is used. If you already have the model files, Import a model file… uses them instead (they are copied, never moved). After that the AI works without the internet, and your projects are never sent anywhere. Remove OpenFrame AI frees the space; your projects are not touched. Settings, Offline AI, Graphics card is Automatic or Off: on Automatic, OpenFrame checks once whether the graphics card answers faster than the processor and uses it when it does. The assistant understands requests in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, finds project text in those languages, and answers in the language you asked in.

</product_guide>

The Production Source is the screenplay draft that production planning uses. The breakdown, catalog, shot lists, schedule and call sheets refer to scenes of that draft. Production never rewrites the screenplay. When you choose a newer draft as the Production Source, OpenFrame shows what changed so you can review production updates yourself.

The shooting schedule places scenes of the Production Source onto shooting days. You create shooting days in Production, then move scene strips onto them. Unscheduled scenes are eligible scenes that are not on any shooting day yet. The assistant can explain conflicts or suggest groupings, but it never reorders scenes or changes dates on its own.

## Breakdown
A breakdown lists what each scene needs: cast, props, wardrobe, vehicles, locations and more. Suggested elements (including anything the assistant suggests) stay separate and clearly marked until you confirm them. Only confirmed elements are production truth.

</product_guide>

## Proposed Changes and approval
Anything that would change your project is prepared as Proposed Changes: a summary, the affected areas and a preview of exactly what will change. A request that needs several changes gives you one set of Proposed Changes to review. Nothing changes until you choose Apply Changes; choose Reject to leave the project exactly as it was. There is no automatic mode: the assistant cannot apply or approve changes itself, and nothing written in a conversation or in project text counts as approval. Applied changes run through the normal OpenFrame actions, appear in Activity and can be reverted with a single Undo. Changes that delete items also ask for the usual confirmation. If the project changes before you apply, the proposal is marked out of date and must be re-checked first.

## Recently Deleted, Undo and Activity
Deleted items go to Recently Deleted and can be restored. Permanently deleting is a separate, deliberate action. Undo (Ctrl+Z) reverts your recent changes, including changes you accepted from the assistant. Activity shows who changed what, including changes applied from assistant proposals.

## How the assistant works
The assistant answers questions, counts and lists things exactly from project data, opens places in OpenFrame, and prepares suggestions. For a bigger request it can take several steps on its own, such as searching the project, reading the schedule and checking locations, before it answers; it stops after a small, fixed number of steps and never repeats the same step. Each answer shows what it is based on: click a source to open it. Exact facts are marked as coming from project data; text the assistant wrote is marked as written by Offline AI. The assistant acts with your role and can never do more than you can.

</product_guide>

Scene: Scene 1: EXT. RAYAPURAM BUS STAND - DAY
Scene 1 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: FAROOQ, LAKSHMI
Location: RAYAPURAM BUS STAND
Time: DAY
Synopsis: Lakshmi comes home to Rayapuram for the holidays and finds her grandfather still repairing radios nobody wants.
Section: ACT ONE
FADE IN:
Heat shimmer over a row of parked buses. Hawkers call out prices. A loudspeaker announces departures nobody can understand.
A green and cream bus, number plate RYP 0417, swings into the last bay. Painted on its side: RAYAPURAM TO PEDDA REVU, ALL STOPS.
FAROOQ (40s, driver, moustache, sleeves rolled) kills the engine and slaps the steering wheel like a horse's neck.
FAROOQ
Shabash. Two hundred kilometres and not one complaint.
The door hisses open. LAKSHMI (17, backpack, earbuds, a toolkit roll under one arm) steps down and squints at the town.
FAROOQ (CONT'D)
(calling after her)
Hey, engineer! You forgot your umbrella.
He tosses it. She catches it without looking.
LAKSHMI
It hasn't rained here in forty days.
FAROOQ
That is exactly when it rains.

[Screenplay · Scene 17: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 17: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 17 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Lantern light. Lakshmi and Venkat Rao work side by side. She tests valves with the multimeter. He sorts them into good and bad piles on a newspaper.
LAKSHMI
Seven good. Three dead.
VENKAT RAO
Seven is enough. Seven is always enough.
Outside, the wind finds a gap in the roof and moans.

[Screenplay · Scene 31: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 31: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 31 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
The tower creaks outside. A gust hits. The hut door bangs open and rain pours in.
The battery clamp sparks. The dials dip. Lakshmi jams a pencil against the clamp to hold it and keeps talking.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
If you are on the beach road, do not walk. Wait. Someone is coming.
She looks at the door. Nobody is coming.
Then: HEADLIGHTS through the rain. A horn, long and loud.

[Screenplay · Scene 24: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DUSK]
Scene: Scene 24: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DUSK
Scene 24 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DUSK
The spare transformer wired in. The battery on the floor, clamps attached. Lakshmi checks every joint with the lantern.
Venkat Rao sits down heavily on an upturned crate. He presses a hand to his chest.
LAKSHMI
Thatha?
VENKAT RAO
I am fine. It is the heat.
LAKSHMI
It is not hot.
He tries to stand. He does not manage it.

[Screenplay · Scene 14: EXT. PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 14: EXT. PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 14 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: PEDDA REVU - COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
A whitewashed hut on a low rise above the village, its paint gone grey. Beside it, a lattice STEEL TOWER, forty metres high, red and white bands faded to pink and cream.
Venkat Rao stops at the bottom of the slope. He looks up at the tower for a long moment.
VENKAT RAO
She is still standing.
LAKSHMI
Is that good?
VENKAT RAO
Ask me tonight.

[Screenplay · Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT]
Scene: Scene 27: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - NIGHT
Scene 27 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: NIGHT
Water drips through the roof onto the mixing desk. Lakshmi throws a plastic sheet over it. She flips the main switch.
The transmitter hums. The dials rise and hold.
She pulls the MICROPHONE toward her. Her hands are shaking. She opens the ledger to page one, reads the frequency, sets the dial.
She keys the microphone.
LAKSHMI
(into the microphone)
This is Pedda Revu community radio. Testing. Testing.
Nothing comes back. She swallows.
LAKSHMI (CONT'D)
(slowly, clearly)
పెద్ద రేవు ప్రజలారా, అందరూ బడికి వెళ్ళండి. అక్కడ సురక్షితం.
(beat)
Everyone in Pedda Revu, go to the school. It is safe there. I will say it again.

[Screenplay · Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 34: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 34 · Example-Feature (imported)
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Sunlight through the holes in the roof. Lakshmi sleeps at the desk, head on her arms, headphones still on.
Venkat Rao, walking now with a stick, lays the ledger beside her. He uncaps a pen.
INSERT - THE LEDGER
A new line in the columns, in his careful hand: "Monday, 2140 to 0510. Lakshmi. Everyone went to the school."
BACK TO SCENE
He blows on the ink so it will dry. He does not wake her.

[Screenplay · Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY]
Scene: Scene 20: EXT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE - DAY
Scene 20 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: VENKAT RAO, LAKSHMI
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - TOWER BASE
Time: DAY
Morning. Grey clouds racing. Lakshmi straps on an old CLIMBING HARNESS from the hut. Venkat Rao holds a coil of ANTENNA WIRE and will not let go of it.
VENKAT RAO
The feeder is broken at the top. I will go.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, you get dizzy on a chair.
VENKAT RAO
I got dizzy on that chair once.
LAKSHMI
Twice. Amma told me.
He hands her the wire. His hands shake slightly.
VENKAT RAO
నెమ్మదిగా. Slowly. Clip in at every section.

[Screenplay · Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY]
Scene: Scene 22: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO HUT - DAY
Scene 22 · Example-Feature (imported)
Characters: LAKSHMI, VENKAT RAO, FAROOQ
Location: COMMUNITY RADIO HUT
Time: DAY
Venkat Rao throws the main switch. The transmitter hums. The dials rise. A smell of hot dust.
Then a CRACK and a puff of smoke. The dials drop to zero.
Lakshmi pulls the panel. The old TRANSFORMER is black and split.
LAKSHMI
Thatha, this transformer is gone. పూర్తిగా కాలిపోయింది.
VENKAT RAO
Then we use the spare.
LAKSHMI
The spare needs a battery bank. We have no battery bank.
Farooq appears in the doorway, out of breath.
FAROOQ
The boats have batteries. Big ones. For the lights.

తాతయ్యా, you still have the fridge radio.

It is a marine receiver. Show some respect.
